entities.summary: Carl Per Gunnar Gahrton was a Swedish politician. He was a member of Parliament, holding a seat for the Liberal Party from 1976 to 1979, and for the Green Party from 1988 to 1991, and again from 1994 to 1995. Later, he was a member of the European Parliament from 1995 to 2004.
